encoding/pem#

Strict textual PEM containers.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let text is string = PemEncoded(
    kind: "PUBLIC KEY",
    data: key_bytes,
).string();

let block = PemBlock(origin: text);
block.kind(); // "PUBLIC KEY"
block.bytes(); // original key_bytes

Description#

Strict textual PEM containers.

PemEncoded uses uppercase labels, standard padded Base64, 64-character body lines and LF. Labels contain uppercase ASCII letters/digits separated by single spaces or hyphens.

Parsing accepts LF and CRLF without normalizing returned data. Empty lines may surround or separate blocks; arbitrary prose and whitespace-only lines are rejected. BEGIN and END labels must match. Body lines contain strict standard Base64, are at most 64 characters, and every nonfinal body line is exactly 64 characters. Bare CR, mixed alphabets, missing padding and junk after a block are errors.

PemBlock requires exactly one block. PemBlocks iterates over zero or more blocks with immutable cursors. InvalidPem.offset() is a Unicode-scalar offset in the original text (or in kind for an invalid encoding label).
